'''2015 MPC Tom Hollingworth LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163223/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
